title: Sign-Up Credit Programme Terms for Small Business Electricity Supply
content:
## Programme terms

1. A Small Business Electricity Supply plan whose sign-up credit is above 0.00 earns one sign-up credit per site once the agreement's completed cycles reach the plan's qualifying cycles, and the credit is posted on the bill of the next cycle.
2. The business sign-up credit may be posted only once per agreement; a sign-up credit line already on the agreement's bill means it has been posted.
3. Business bill credits are posted only while the agreement is active or drop pending, as shown by the agreement record's status.
4. An enrollment through the broker channel earns the sign-up credit only when the plan makes broker enrollments eligible.
5. When the plan forfeits an unposted sign-up credit on a drop and the agreement left active status before qualifying, the credit is forfeited.
6. Renewals, automatic renewals, rollovers and site transfers never earn a sign-up credit.
7. Credits are additive, each posted as its own line, and none offsets a fee or sales tax.

## Completed cycles

The agreement's completed cycles are counted from its service start date up to the handling date: they are the number of distinct billing cycles (distinct cycle start dates) among the agreement's energy charge lines whose cycle end date is on or before the handling date.

Hypothetical count, service start 5 January, handling date 10 April:

| Energy line's cycle | Ends on or before 10 April | Counted |
|---|---|---|
| 5 January to 3 February | yes | 1 |
| 4 February to 5 March | yes | 2 |
| 6 March to 4 April | yes | 3 |
| 5 April to 4 May | no | not counted |

With 3 completed cycles, an agreement on a plan with 3 qualifying cycles has qualified, and its sign-up credit appears on the bill of the next cycle, the one beginning 5 April.

## Points of judgement

| Situation | Sign-up credit |
|---|---|
| Plan's sign-up credit is 0.00 | none earned |
| Enrolled through a broker, plan not broker-eligible | not earned |
| Agreement left active status before qualifying, plan forfeits on drop | forfeited |
| Agreement came about by renewal, automatic renewal, rollover or site transfer | never earned on that event |
| A sign-up credit line is already on the agreement's bill | not posted again |
| Agreement closed | no bill credit is posted |
